title: Puzzle2d Live Peer Sync
description: Restore commit-93 canvas speed while keeping commit-94 live cross-pane node-move/delete sync, by replacing per-frame full-scene WASM re-push on peer panes with lightweight incremental per-node position update in Rust/WASM BoardSession.
summary: Hover/zoom/selection slowness was mostly React + redundant per-event work, not GPU like drag. Fixed: coalesce repaint to one RAF per frame (scheduleInputInvalidate) for hover/pan/wheel while WASM still gets every event; publishHover only when hovered id changes; stop lifting hover to triptych React state (removed hoveredId/onHover from play canvases); broadcast selection to peer panes via applySelectionFromPeerSilent before shell re-render. 92 vitest pass.
